lines.t: Walk the narrow path of mercy,
Turn away from shadow’s call,
Hold your heart in sacred honor,
Let your spirit never fall.
Every whisper yields a choice,
Every step, a solemn vow,
To seek the truth in all creation,
And live as holy conscience allows.
You shall guard what’s pure and rightful,
Leave behind what’s stained and flawed,
Turn away from all defilement,
Stand in grace before your God.
Temptation waits with gentle promise,
But wisdom speaks with steady flame,
Walk with courage through the silence,
And rise above the weight of shame.
Every breath can cleanse the soul,
Every act can light the dark,
When your will aligns with heaven,
You reflect the Father’s spark.
You shall guard what’s pure and rightful,
Leave behind what’s stained and flawed,
Turn away from all defilement,
Stand in grace before your God.
Let your heart be strong, unbroken,
Let your faith be firm and true,
For the eyes of God are watching,
And His mercy covers you.
You shall guard what’s pure and rightful,
Seek His way, obey His call,
Turn from sin and worldly shadow,
Stand in the light that claims us all.
